description: List the incoming calls answered by one of the signed-in owner's own lines, newest first, with the full caller number (E.164 or null) that get_answering_line shows only as its last four digits. Each item has id, at (ISO), caller, duration_seconds, summary when there is one, and urgent when known. Pass the line_id from get_answering_line; limit sets the page size, and to read further back pass the previous result's next_before as before (next_before is null when there is nothing older). It covers recent calls only, so older ones may not be returned. No audio links or transcripts: open the call in the owner console (https://odilelabs.com/owner). The messages callers left are in get_line_messages, and calls you placed with call_business are read with get_call_result. Needs lines:manage; changes nothing; rate limited per account.

before.description: ISO timestamp cursor: only calls before this.

name: get_line_calls
title: One line's recent calls
